newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's assigns ratings to Norgeskreditt debt.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns ratings to Norgeskreditt debt.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Moody's said on Friday it had assigned ratings to mortgage lender Norgeskreditt's $750 million euro debt issuance programme.
The ratings assigned were A2 senior unsecured debt, A3 senior subordinated debt and Prime-1 shortterm debt.
Norgeskreditt was acquired by Christiania Bank in July 1996 and in now a fully owned subsidiary.

Moody's said the ratings reflect Norgeskreditt's satisfactory financial fundamentals and the potential for revenue enhancement and enhanced cost efficiency which arise following the acquisition by Christiania Bank.
